facts.text: Chartered in 1883, Reinhardt started classes in January 1884 for 12 students in an old cabinet and wood shop.

sources.title: University History
sources.quote: The Conference chartered the new school in 1883, naming the Reverend James T. Linn as its first teacher and president. In January 1884, the institution started classes for 12 students in an old cabinet and wood shop.
